name: The Alliance Needs More Arthas' Tears!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Arthas' Tears!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ok, so it looks like I still need more Arthas' Tears. I would imagine that you will be able to find them in the general location that you gathered them up for me last time. The quicker we get these, the faster we can start up the offensive against the forces at Ahn'Qiraj.
You gonna help us out again adventurer?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ok, so it looks like I still need more Arthas' Tears, adventurer. I would imagine that you will be able to find them in the general location that you gathered them up last time. The war effort is coming along nicely, but the quicker we get these, the faster we can start up the offensive against the forces at Ahn'Qiraj.
You gonna help us out again, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Simply outstanding, friend! You're a real credit to the Alliance. I'll make sure to get these herbs packed away until someone comes to make them into something useful for the war. Feel free to come back around anytime, especially if you have more Arthas' Tears for me.
